name: oklch-palette-generator
description: Figma plugin for generating OKLCH color palettes

scripts.build: npm run build:code && npm run build:ui
scripts.fix:html: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('dist','public','public','index.html');const dest=path.join('dist','public','index.html');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.renameSync(src,dest);fs.rmSync(path.join('dist','public','public'),{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('✅ HTML movido a ubicación correcta');}"
